dict.string: Sayi needs microphone access to capture your voice for transcription.
Sayi uses Apple Speech Recognition to convert your speech into text.
Sayi needs Apple Events access to paste transcription results into the active application.
Sayi needs Screen Recording permission to capture system audio (speakers or headphones) in "system only" or "both" mode. No video is recorded.
Sayi needs to capture system audio output (including headphones) for transcribing and translating playback content.
